findings: Removing a focused inline expansion lets Android focus the first tab and triggers an unintended tab switch; three playback regressions expose the same cause.
At 150 percent text, supplementary vote count line requires 21 px but proportional height gives 20 px.
corrections: Move focus to the current parent before removing its expansion subtree.
Measure vote-count height from its text rather than assigning a proportional height.
acceptance: Not passing evidence; rerun required. No hardware testing.
